name: Link
statusNote: Link is a styled anchor used throughout GitHub; alpha is Primer's label. The deprecated hoverColor prop is still accepted but now ignored.
summary: Inline navigational text in the accent colour, underlined on hover (or always, inside prose, when the user asks for link underlines). Choose it to navigate; choose Button with variant link for an action that should look like text.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: The link's content, normally text, inheriting the surrounding font and size.

inputs.name: href
inputs.description: The destination. Without it, render as a button (the as: button form) for an action that reads as a link.

inputs.name: muted
inputs.description: Draw in --fgColor-muted at rest, turning accent on hover; for secondary links in metadata.

inputs.name: inline
inputs.description: The link sits inside a block of prose; it is then underlined at rest when the user's link-underline preference is on.

inputs.name: onClick
inputs.description: Activation; required for the button form.

anatomy.name: Text
anatomy.description: The inline text run in --fgColor-accent with no underline at rest; the underline, when drawn, sits 0.05rem below the default position.

variants.description: Muted text at rest; on hover it turns accent and is not underlined.
Not inline: no underline at rest whatever the user preference.
Inline in prose: with link underlines on, underlined at rest and not on hover (the hover cue inverts).
Rendered as a button: inline-block, no padding, border or background, the surrounding font size, one line (no wrapping), pointer cursor, no text selection.

layout.text: An anchor is pure inline text: no box, padding or height, the surrounding font, size and line height, and it wraps with the text around it.
The button form is inline-block with no padding, border or background, inherits the font size, and never wraps (white-space: nowrap).
The underline is offset 0.05rem (0.8px at a 16px root) below its default position.

states.text: --fgColor-accent (muted: --fgColor-muted), no underline; with link underlines on, an inline link is underlined.
Underline the text. A muted link instead turns --fgColor-accent with no underline; an inline link under the underline preference drops its underline.

The module draws no focus style. On the web the browser's default focus ring shows on keyboard focus and BaseStyles removes it after a pointer press; a native build must draw a keyboard-only ring itself.

behaviour.text: Activate on pointer release or Enter (and Space for the button form); an anchor navigates to href, the button form calls onClick.
Colour and underline change at once on hover; the module declares no transition.

keyboard: Enter follows the link; the button form also activates on Space.
semantics: Its name is its text content.
Primer requires it to render as a real anchor or button and reports an error in development otherwise.

notes.text: Link reads --fgColor-accent while Button's link variant reads --fgColor-link. They resolve to the same colour in every theme today (fgColor-link aliases fgColor-accent), but a native build should keep the two paths separate.
minTargetPx is null because a link's hit area is its text's line box, as small as the surrounding text; Primer sets no minimum target.
The hoverColor prop is destructured and discarded, so passing it has no effect; do not implement it.
The underline preference is an ancestor attribute (data-a11y-link-underlines) that GitHub sets from a user setting; a native build needs an app-level flag that inline links read.
An anchor wraps across lines with the surrounding text, so its hover and hit region is a set of line fragments, not one rectangle. An immediate-mode text layout must hit-test the link's glyph runs.
Keyboard focus visibility comes from the browser's default outline, not from Primer; the focus-visible suppression in BaseStyles only removes it after a pointer press.
For a native focus ring, follow Button's link variant: Primer's 2px --focus-outline-color outline offset 2px outside the text.
